display_title: A Love Story of Heaven and Hell, Part 2
description:
Our favorite celestial couple is back for a steamier and more dramatic season! Sara, the Queen of Hell, is annoyed as ever with her puppy-dog husband, Marshall. It's only worse because the King of Heaven is all grown up now and wants to do (ahem) grown-up things, but Sara just doesn't have the time to entertain all his hormonal desires when she has a kingdom to run. All this sexual frustration causes a fight between the two that climaxes into a freak accident - Marshall splits into two people after getting mixed up with one of Sara's magic spells! But are these two kings the same person, or is one just a copy of the other? Whatever the truth is, Sara will have to manage double the trouble until she can turn Marshall back into one person again! 

(Source: Tappytoon)
